summary: Frontend regression for RevenueCat key hardening + paywall diagnostics (app.json v1.0.1, PW-2026.10.01-d). All 4 user-story items pass against the public web preview (390x844). ONE ENV CAVEAT: Metro had a stale cache from before the app.json version bump, so the paywall footer initially rendered 'v1.0.0'. After `rm -rf /app/frontend/.metro-cache /app/frontend/.expo` + `supervisorctl restart expo`, the live stamp correctly reads 'v1.0.1 · build — · PW-2026.10.01-d · key test_PtKHf…'. Diagnostics (triple-tap on paywall-plan-card) print 'RC key: test_PtKHf… (project: Jaleter Budgeting App)', 'last bind: configure(appUserID=user_…) ok', and 'RC user: user_… (linked)' exactly as specified. Full IAP flow (paywall-iap-buy → paywall-iap-confirm → paywall-iap-confirm-yes → RC Test Store 'Test valid purchase') unlocks the dashboard end-to-end. No new console errors from rcActiveKeyMasked / getLastBindResult; only expected 402s from premium-gated endpoints before unlock.
action_items: ENV HOUSEKEEPING (not a code bug): after bumping app.json version, Metro's cached web bundle must be invalidated for Constants.expoConfig.version to update. The paywall footer rendered 'v1.0.0' until I cleared /app/frontend/.metro-cache and /app/frontend/.expo and restarted expo via supervisor. Suggest doing this (or running `expo start --clear`) as part of any version bump going forward.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (not from this iteration): require-cycle warning src/lib/revenuecat.tsx ↔ src/AuthContext.tsx is logged on every boot. Harmless today but worth untangling to avoid future 'uninitialized value' bugs — apiCall is imported from AuthContext inside revenuecat.tsx while AuthContext also imports from revenuecat.tsx.
seed_data_creation: Registered one throwaway test user via UI (iter91x<unix_ts>@example.com / TestPass123!) to exercise the hard-paywall. Nothing to clean — fresh anonymous accounts only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To bypass the WebView 'Get Started' iframe on web, drive navigation with `page.evaluate("window.postMessage('navigate:onboarding', '*')")`. For the Test Store confirm flow on web preview: paywall-iap-buy → paywall-iap-confirm (first tap only sets confirmTestBuy) → paywall-iap-confirm-yes → RC Test Store overlay with text 'Test valid purchase' (click that to simulate a successful purchase). Dashboard unlock takes ~5-8s because /api/iap/sync + checkMembership round-trip. The 3× plan-card toggle re-fires showDiagnostics; a 4th tap would clear it.
rca_of_issue: The reported 'v1.0.1' stamp was the only test item that initially failed. Root cause: Metro bundler had cached the web JS bundle built against the pre-bump app.json (version 1.0.0). Constants.expoConfig is baked into the bundle at build time, so `supervisorctl restart expo` alone did not refresh it — Metro served the same cached chunks on restart. Mitigation: wipe /app/frontend/.metro-cache and /app/frontend/.expo before restarting expo (equivalent of `expo start --clear`). After that, the footer immediately rendered 'v1.0.1 · build — · PW-2026.10.01-d · key test_PtKHf…' as spec'd.
